principle: What promotion boards value shifts with SECWAR/SECAF/CSO priorities and with each administration. This file records what is known NOW, with sources, so drafting can emphasize it. Never treat it as permanent: re-verify each board cycle (impact-research step), and let users override it in _opr_work/board_priorities.json.

priorities.summary: Joint experience: assignment to a joint staff or combatant-command staff, including component commands serving a CCMD (e.g. U.S. Space Forces-Indo-Pacific) or the joint command itself.
priorities.drafting_effect: Lead with joint-staff/CCMD impacts; state the joint audience served (CCDR, JTF, component). Push lines can name joint-staff/CCMD jobs as the next assignment.
priorities.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026; reflects current SECWAR/SECAF emphasis - re-verify each board cycle

priorities.summary: Headquarters Space Force / Headquarters Air Force staff time is highly valued.
priorities.drafting_effect: Surface HQ-level work and staff impact; HQSF/HAF staff is a strong next-assignment push.
priorities.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026; reflects current SECWAR/SECAF emphasis - re-verify each board cycle

priorities.summary: Pentagon time (often joint as well) is highly valued.
priorities.drafting_effect: Name Pentagon/OSD/Joint Staff exposure explicitly; Pentagon staff is a strong push.
priorities.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026; reflects current SECWAR/SECAF emphasis - re-verify each board cycle

priorities.summary: Time and experience in the Indo-Pacific theater is highly valued.
priorities.drafting_effect: Highlight Indo-Pacific exercises, deployments, and support (USINDOPACOM, SFI, SFK, SFJ, USFK, USFJ; Korea/Japan/Pacific exercises) with joint metrics.
priorities.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026; reflects current SECWAR/SECAF emphasis - re-verify each board cycle

priorities.summary: Six-month deployments (e.g. CJTF-OIR) are valued, but less than joint, HQ, Pentagon, or Indo-Pacific experience.
priorities.drafting_effect: Show deployed joint/coalition impact with metrics; don't let a deployment crowd out stronger joint/HQ items.
priorities.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026; reflects current SECWAR/SECAF emphasis - re-verify each board cycle

priorities.summary: Physical fitness scores are a NEW board data point (2026): boards are expected to weigh them heavily. Fitness has never appeared on OPRs before; placement on the DAF 707 is not yet published.
priorities.drafting_effect: Always capture the member's current fitness score/category and test date at intake. Record it in draft.ratee.fitness_score. The DOCX shows it as a Box I 'FITNESS SCORE:' line by default (draft.ratee.fitness_placement: box1 | remarks | both | none) until the official placement is published.
priorities.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026; driven by current administration/SECWAR emphasis
priorities.verify: Check the latest DAFI/SpFI 36-2406/36-2401 changes, PFA/fitness guidance, and board convening instructions.

priorities.summary: Alignment with the current Chief of Space Operations' published priorities (C-Notes, speeches, vectors). Gen Schiess became CSO on 3 Sep 2026; Gen Saltzman's C-Notes cover Nov 2022 - Aug 2026.
priorities.drafting_effect: Tie impacts to the CSO priority in force during the reporting period (ref_lookup.py --source cso).
priorities.verify: Check the CSO Leadership Library for notices issued after Sep 2026.

career_guidance.source: rating-chain knowledge (user), Sep 2026 - re-verify each board cycle

notes: Materiel Leader (ML) jobs open only at Lt Col, and Senior Materiel Leader (SML) at Col.
Acquisition has fewer competitively boarded leadership positions than operations, so pushes should name the ML/SML path and the staff jobs that lead to it.

Program Element Monitor (PEM): manages, advocates for and oversees one Program Element's budget and capability line. Always a Pentagon job (HQSF or HAF), so it also meets the Pentagon priority. Highly desirable for acquisition officers (USSF and USAF equally) as a Maj, or as a Lt Col not yet done. Acquisition only; never an operations push.

push_by_grade.O-4: PEM (HQSF/HAF, Pentagon) or ML next (ML opens at Lt Col)
push_by_grade.O-5: ML; PEM if not yet done; SML next (opens at Col)

notes: Operations has more boarded command: Det CC at Maj, Deputy Sq CC at senior Maj, Sq CC at Lt Col.

push_by_grade.O-4: Det CC; Deputy Sq CC (senior Maj); Sq CC next (at Lt Col)

items: Space Test Course / Space Test Program
other competitively boarded schools and programs

education_gates.requirement: IDE (as a Maj select or Maj) and an Advanced Academic Degree are required to be competitive for Lt Col.
SDE (as a Lt Col select or Lt Col) is required to be competitive for Col.

career_guidance.note: Education gates guide development advice and DE pushes only. Completion of DE or a degree is still prohibited OPR content (unit policy decides degree mentions).
